text_block_list.text:
With the opening address concluded,
the Fan
Fest begins in earnest. Symboli
Rudolf's big
moment will be the
exhibition race at the end of
the event.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite technically being a ceremonial
race, it's
certain to be competitive. If
possible, I'd like her
to spend the
morning resting up, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So, in short, the carrot-picking event is
struggling
for attendees?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
That's right. It looks like the scavenger
hunt
behind it is getting all of the
attention.
text_block_list.name: Student Council Member

text_block_list.text:
That won't be very encouraging for the
students
running it. What other large
events are on at the
moment?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Um... well, there's the cosplay race. It's
out on the
school track.
text_block_list.name: Student Council Member

text_block_list.text:
That's relatively close by. We can try
funneling
attendees to the carrot
picking event from there.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Let's extend the time we have posted for
it as
well. I'll give Team G permission to
make the
changes.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Roger that, President! I'll do that right
away!
text_block_list.name: Student Council Member

text_block_list.text: ...Phew.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: Seems like you've got a lot on your plate.

text_block_list.text:
I apologize. I should know better than to
sigh like
that in public.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And I should not be making you look
after me,
either. Go on, look around.
Explore.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The students have put their all into
making this
festival as good as it can be.
I want as many
people as possible to
enjoy themselves.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Much as I'd love to enjoy the festival, it's
hard not
to worry when she looks so
tired.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Not that it's much of a surprise. The
combination
of training, student council
duties, and planning
the festival has
been running her ragged.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ah, President. Here you are.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув. How can I help you?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I sent a you request for additional
resources a
little while ago, but I never
received a reply.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry, it slipped my mind.
Your
request is approved. You may go
ahead.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Very well. If you'll excuse me.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Thank you. And sorry for the trouble.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
What a blunder. I hardly deserve to call
myself
president...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're not just tired?

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps so, but the failure is still mine. If
I cannot
look after my own well-being,
what good am I?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: No, I must pull myself together.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The spectators at the exhibition race are

expecting to see me at full strength.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
A great number of students will filter in
after the
other races finish as well. I have
to show them a
performance worthy of
the Emperor.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're going to be all right?

text_block_list.text:
Haha. Never fear. I'm always all right, am
I not?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Now, go ahead and enjoy the Fan Fest. I
need to
return to the student council
office to receive
some more reports.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The event continues smoothly thanks to
the
efforts of the student council, but I
can't quite
shake a lingering sense of
unease.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for the event you've all
been
waiting for: the Академия Тайсен
exhibition race!
text_block_list.name: Commentator

text_block_list.text:
Needless to say, all eyes are on the
Emperor,
Симболи Рудольф! How will she
rule the track
today? The crowd is
buzzing with anticipation!
text_block_list.name: Commentator

text_block_list.text: Wooooo! Go Rudooolf!
text_block_list.name: Crowd

text_block_list.text: The crowd is more curious about how Symboli Rudolf will win, rather than whether she'll win... but that's not how things pan out.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And we're coming into the final stretch...
but it
looks like Симболи Рудольф is having
some trouble!
text_block_list.name: Commentator

text_block_list.text:
There's someone coming up on the
outside, but
it's not Симболи Рудольф!
It's—
text_block_list.name: Commentator

text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
What the heck was that? Isn't she
supposed to be
the Emperor?
text_block_list.name: Spectator

text_block_list.text:
I've never seen the President run so
slow... What
happened?
text_block_list.name: Spectating Student

text_block_list.text: President...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
In the end, Симболи Рудольф never
manages to
separate herself from the
pack. It's a
disappointing performance
for the Emperor, and
the crowd knows it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
